name: docker-compose-svc
title: Docker Compose service
blurb: Docker Compose service: a small HTTP service shipped as a container — compose file with a real healthcheck, non-root image, unit tests that need nothing, and a smoke test that starts the container and checks every answer

verify.name: no-leftovers
verify.cmd: test -z "$(docker compose ps -q)" && echo 'no containers left running'
